question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Sharp and direct
solution: The correct answer is **acerbic**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Acerbic: **(especially of a comment or style of speaking) sharp and forthright. ((विशेष रूप से टिप्पणी या बोलने की शैली) तेज और स्पष्ट) • **Example:** The letters show the **acerbic **wit for which Parker was both admired and feared. • Thus, the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Zoonic: **concerning animals; obtained from animal substances. (जानवरों के संबंध में; पशु पदार्थों से प्राप्त) • **Anodyne: **not likely to cause offence or disagreement and somewhat dull; a painkilling drug or medicine. (कुछ ऐसा जिससे असहमति होने की संभावना न हो ;पीड़ा-नाशक) • **Acidic: **sharp-tasting or sour. (अम्लीय) 34:T956, The correct answer is **enthusiastic**.
